title: From Grounding to Planning: Benchmarking Bottlenecks in Web Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of word counts in ground truth candidates and implementing a length-aware sampling strategy (grouping by 1-3, 4-6, and 7+ words) to counteract the LLM's tendency to disproportionately favor candidate elements with longer texts.

Observing the physical coordinates of ground truth elements on web pages to identify a clustering effect towards the top and left sides, and countering this by splitting candidates based on their Y-axis position and applying an over-sampling strategy for elements located in the upper 700 pixels.
